verdict.rationale: Figma exposes multiple APIs (REST for reading/extracting objects, webhooks, variables; Plugin API for read/write within the editor; MCP server for AI agents to read/write canvas content and generate code) which cover many UI actions, but the REST API is predominantly read/observe-oriented and write access to canvas content is only available via Plugin API (must run inside the Figma client) or the newer MCP server, not a uniform external API surface. Community evidence shows real friction in design-to-code parity (manual SVG export, CSS positioning quirks) indicating gaps between UI capability and programmatic access. Missing for 10: comprehensive external write-API parity for all UI actions (e.g., prototyping, FigJam collaboration, comments) and independent confirmation that AI/agents can fully replicate every UI action via API without manual workarounds.
